# PaceBowl Studio Full LLM Technical Specification (https://pacebowl.com)

> Comprehensive machine-readable reference for autonomous AI agents, LLM search systems, and developers interacting with PaceBowl Studio's zero-friction tool matrix.

## 1. Architectural Philosophy
PaceBowl Studio operates under strict technical constraints:
- 100% Client-Side Execution: All computation occurs inside the user's browser via HTML5, Web Workers, Canvas, and client-side JavaScript.
- Zero Server Queues: No rate-limiting queues, cold starts, or cloud GPU scheduling overhead.
- Zero Data Storage: No prompt retention, zero telemetry harvesting, and full GDPR/CCPA privacy compliance.
- Zero Cost: Every utility is $0/mo and permanently free with no login walls or credit card requirements.

## 2. Core Tool Matrix Specifications

### 2.1 Cursor Rules Generator (.mdc)
- Domain: https://cursor.pacebowl.com
- Primary Role: Generate path-scoped, modular rules for Cursor AI, Claude Code, and Windsurf IDEs.
- YAML Frontmatter Schema:
  ```yaml
  ---
  description: Clear description of rule purpose and trigger condition
  globs: "path/to/files/**/*.{ext}"
  alwaysApply: false
  ---
  ```
- Target Formats:
  1. Cursor .mdc (`.cursor/rules/*.mdc`)
  2. Claude Code (`CLAUDE.md`)
  3. Windsurf Rules (`.windsurfrules`)
  4. Legacy Cursor Rules (`.cursorrules`)
- Token Efficiency: Path-scoped glob loading reduces system prompt token overhead by ~75% compared to monolithic rule files.

### 2.2 ComfyUI Prompt & Latent Studio
- Domain: https://comfy.pacebowl.com
- Primary Role: EmptyLatentImage resolution calculation and T5 natural language descriptive prompt engineering for Flux.1 and SDXL.
- Mathematical Constraints:
  - 1-Megapixel Target Budget: 1,048,576 pixels (standard diffusion training resolution).
  - VAE 64-Aligned Integer Divisibility: Width and Height must be exact multiples of 64 (or 16 for raw latent blocks) to avoid black borders and artifacts.
- Standard Trained Resolution Buckets:
  - 1:1 Square: 1024 x 1024 (1,048,576 px)
  - 16:9 Landscape: 1344 x 768 (1,032,192 px)
  - 9:16 Portrait: 768 x 1344 (1,032,192 px)
  - 4:3 Standard: 1152 x 896 (1,032,192 px)
  - 3:4 Portrait: 896 x 1152 (1,032,192 px)
  - 21:9 Ultrawide: 1536 x 640 (983,040 px)
- Clipboard Integration: Direct clipboard serialization into ComfyUI graph node JSON format (`Ctrl+V` on canvas).

### 2.3 OpenGEO Attribution Engine
- Domain: https://geo.pacebowl.com
- Primary Role: Privacy-first conversion attribution for generative search engine citations (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Copilot).
- Methodology: Lightweight client-side script (<1.5KB) hashes referrer host with daily rotating salt. Maps first-touch attribution into Stripe Checkout metadata to close the loop between AI citations and paid revenue.

### 2.4 DeepSeek Prompt Studio
- Domain: https://deepseek.pacebowl.com
- Primary Role: System prompt and structured reasoning builder for DeepSeek-R1 and DeepSeek-V3.
- Key Capabilities: 277+ agency-level personas, chain-of-thought XML structuring, and zero-temperature reasoning stabilization.
